beforeBrief.whatIsHappening: PDAC 2027 Convention (7–10 March 2027, MTCC) publishes Radisson Blu Toronto Downtown as an official hotel partner with promo rate CAD $449 and reference code for direct booking (cutoff 2 Feb 2027). Limited availability remains on select nights.
beforeBrief.whyThisHotel: 157 guestrooms / ~11,000 sq ft / 20 meeting rooms on Queens Quay — realistic for mid-size groups, overflow, and meeting+rooms packages; not exclusive MTCC mega-housing. PDAC official partner list includes this hotel at 8-minute walk to MTCC.
beforeBrief.potentialHotelBusiness: Fill remaining partner-rate inventory; pursue exhibitor/company suites and overflow once partner nights sell; do not confuse with exclusive venue housing.
beforeBrief.whyActNow: Partner promo cutoff 2 Feb 2027; limited availability already flagged on select nights.
beforeBrief.recommendedNextStep: Qualify before pursuing — no direct route is published; a Radisson Blu participant/partner listing already exists, so this is account management of an existing listing rather than new prospecting.
